lines.en: : Oh...hi.
: Hey, Chika. I didn’t see you around yesterday. What are you up to?
: Just...going to breakfast. Nothing special.
: Cool.
: Yes. It is cool.
: Very cool.
: Okay. You seem weird today. Something is going on.
: I’m sorry. I wasn’t prepared to see you and I don’t know how to act.
: I didn’t realize that was something you needed to prepare for.
: It wasn’t always. But life is a lot more complicated now and I haven’t completely rediscovered myself yet.
: Is that...something I can help with? Or something that is simply a symptom of me leading you on for so long?
: I mean...I wouldn’t say you led me on...
: I would. That is kind of literally what happened by not being outwardly honest with you and allowing you to keep thinking we were exclusive.
: True but, to be fair, it’s not like I’m entirely blameless. Like, how was I supposed to know that Niki was actually your childhood friend and that you were sleeping with her too.
: Probably from me telling you that.
: Right, but why would I believe it?
: Probably because her little sister is in your class and has not been candid about being in love with me since she was a kid.
: Love is blind, okay?!
: Like the TV show?
: How do you even know about that?! You don’t watch TV!
: No, but Niki does. And I have known her since we were both children, so-
: Yes, I’m aware of that now and don’t need to be reminded anymore!
: Sorry. Just making sure.
: Either way, I get it now! My perfect dream world has been shattered and I must now face the fact that I don’t actually have the perfect storybook romance with a cool older guy I thought I did.
: It was...naive of me to expect everything to work out perfectly. So why don’t we just both share some of the blame and try to move on or something?...
: Chika, do you really think I’m still the right person for you? Like, be honest.
: What do you mean?...
: I mean you obviously don’t want this. You’re just clinging to me now because you’re afraid of losing me or something. You could do so much better and we both know it.
: Are you actually breaking up with me then?...
: Hah...do you want to come inside? This probably isn’t a conversation we should have in the hall.
: If you’re going to break up with me, you can do it here. Don’t invite me in for it.
: I am entering my room now. You may follow if you wish to continue this conversation.
: Well, of course I want to continue the conversation! As it stands, I don’t know if I still have a boyfriend or not!
: I’m surprised you’re still calling me that, honestly. I figured that, if anything, knowing you’re sharing with Niki would dissuade you from even wanting the title of “girlfriend.”
: I just don’t know what I’d call myself otherwise. Like, we’re clearly more than just friends and it’s not like I’m trying to become your mistress or something.
: And I’m not trying to make you into that. So whatever you want to call yourself is fine by me.
: Wait, are you not dumping me then? Because it seemed like you were taking me in here to do that.
: Of course not. What sort of idiot would let a girl like you go?
: I’d much rather you just suffer than deal with not having you at all.
: That’s both super mean and super cute at the same time! I don’t know how I’m supposed to interpret it!
: Sit down. Let’s talk.
: Uhh...should we maybe, like...clean up first? Looks like you...were busy last night.
: Don’t be too impressed. The smallest pile is mine. I’m not sure how Imani and Wakana are doing, though.
: I heard Miss Watabe left this morning. Too hungover, maybe?
: Uhh...maybe. I haven’t really talked to her yet.
: This feels kinda weird, honestly. The vibes are totally different from when the two of us went to the ryokan I won tickets for.
: Yeah. For one, I can still breathe. I learned things about you that weekend I hope no one else ever learns.
: Yeah...Yeah, I know you...aren’t as open to me being with anyone else as I am with you.
: Let’s not pretend you’re okay with it either, Chika. No more hiding things from each other. You hate who I am, but you love me at the same time. And that’s perfectly normal.
: Well, don’t sound too beat up over it.
: I don’t sound “beat up” because I’ve been waiting for this since we first got involved. You were always going to wind up hurting like this and it was always going to be because of me.
: Would it have killed you to at least warn me, though?
: I’ve obviously had my fair share of tragedy, Sensei. But finding out you weren’t as faithful as I thought you were hit me just as hard as the rest of the terrible stuff I’ve been through.
: It’s just...been so much, you know? Like, I thought you were the thing all of my hard work finally landed me. And that things would finally start to get a little easier so long as we were in love.
: Turns out, I have never been more wrong about anything in my life. And that it’s all even harder now because I fell for someone like you.
: Do you regret it?
: It’s okay if you do, Chika. And if you’re worried about hurting my feelings, don’t be. You’ve more or less earned the right to do that whenever you want now.
: I feel like “regret” isn’t the right word.
: Like...sometimes it feels like it is. And I look back at all that’s happened and I’m just...fucking angry. At you. At me. Even at Niki, who hasn’t technically done anything wrong.
: Regretting it makes it sound like I wish it never happened, though. And that’s not true. I just wish it didn’t hurt so much.

: And I’m sorry it did. But I’ll be here so long as you need me to be here. And I’m still more than happy to fill out a page or two in that “storybook” you want. I can’t do it all, though. So if there’s someone-
: What if there is someone?
: What if...hypothetically speaking...there is someone else I’ve developed...feelings for?
: And what if it made more sense to be with them than it does with you in every possible way?
: What if that person brought me the same sort of joy you did, just without the fear of them sleeping with everyone I know and breaking my heart in the process?
: Would you want me to be with that person so long as it brings me happiness? Or would you really rather I continue suffering just so you can feel a little less terrible inside?
: It’s not an easy question, is it?
: Do you see what I’ve been living with now? The things I’ve had to think because of you?
: I’m in high school.
: Look at what you’ve done to me.
: Look at who I am now.

: I’m supposed to be worried about my homework or what my plans are this weekend. Not which one of my friends my teacher is fucking tonight or how I’m supposed to keep the lights on with a part-time job.

: What if I want to be normal? Just for a little bit? Date someone my age? Someone I relate to. Who I’m attracted to. Who I can see myself growing older with when you’ve already gone and done that without me.
: Are these things you want to keep from me, Sensei? Are these feelings I should ignore just to make you feel better?
: Is that...
: Is someone expecting you?...
: Yes, but-
: Just answer it. I’m not going anywhere.
: It’ll just take a minute, okay? I made plans with Rin, but I can have her wait a little longer since this is obviously-
: It’s fine. I can wait.
: Just one second. Sorry.
: Hello?...
: No, I’m not ghosting you. Just in the middle of something right now.
: No, I’m still coming. I’ll just be a few minutes late.
: Yeah. Yeah, see you then.
: Sorry, so-
: Feels like it was just the other day me and her were meeting up here while you were off doing your own thing.
: Sure, but I feel like there’s something more important you’re not telling me right now.
: It’s kind of funny...How you bring up something like “regrets” and then immediately that happens.
: Imagine I said yes to her back then? How different things would be right now?
: How you wouldn’t be getting that call at all and I wouldn’t be on the brink of tears in the same room you probably slept with someone else last night? How did any of this happen?
: How did we get here?...
: Chika...is there-
: A few months ago, I went into Rin’s room to console her after her mom caught her trying to sext you.
: She thought I was going to be mad because she knew how much I love you. And that I wouldn’t approve of her chasing after you next despite the two of us being such good friends.
: And I was mad. Furious, even. But not because of that.
: It was because I imagined you hurting her. I imagined the confusion she hasn’t had the chance to face yet. I imagined you touching her the way you touch me.
: It made my blood boil. But it all happened so fast. So I thought to myself, “What’s the best way to make all of this stop?”
: What can I do to comfort her? To comfort both of us and stop all of these terrible, sad feelings?
: Chika-
: I pushed her down on the bed. I took her panties off. And then I ate her out.
: I think that part of me hoped she’d fall for me again. That she’d realize I like her the way she used to like me and stop chasing after you.
: But of course, I failed. And I confused the ever living hell out of her in the process because she, at least up until then, thought all we were was friends. And I think she was right.
: I think I ruined that. But even now, I can’t stop thinking about her. And I want to be more than that. But I want to be more than that with you too, so...what does this make me?

: I want you. I want her. But I don’t want the two of you to have each other. And I feel bad about that. But I also don’t want to feel bad about that because I want you to understand what it’s like to be us.
: Are you mad at me?
: Because you should be.
: You should feel betrayed and unwanted and lost and confused and all of the other things I’ve felt because of you.
: But you should also feel seen. Because someone finally gets it.
: Because I finally understand what it’s like to love two people at once.
: Can you still love me even if I am like this?
: You...
: What...What about her, though? Because Rin is still freaking out since the two of you are-
: The reason I’m able to talk to you right now is specifically because I distanced myself from her.
: If I didn’t, it would have been the same thing all over again. Where I get so obsessed that nothing else matters and I wind up ruining the part of my life that I love.
: And it’s better for her too. She’s less confused this way. And she can let you hurt her if that is truly what she wants.
: I...have no idea what to say here.
: Like, I obviously don’t have the right to be mad, but-
: Yes you do.
: I’m your girlfriend. Remember? And I went and cheated on you with somebody else.
: Yes. But I-
: Two wrongs don’t make a right.
: Okay, but I have way more than just two wrongs under my belt.
: Two, three, a thousand. I don’t think it really matters.
: It always hurts when something or someone you’re passionate about winds up not being all it’s cracked up to be.
: And we’re both that to each other now. So the question is if we’ll keep being that way or just...
: Run off somewhere else and...be something else. If we even can. If we’re not just kidding ourselves.
: When did you realize you loved her?...
: That’s the cruelest part of all...
: It was the second she realized she loves you.
: I’m sorry. I really am. But I have no regrets...and I think that means I’m growing.
: Or regressing. It’s because of what you’re feeling that I don’t grow and likely never will.
: Don’t ever let anyone be ignorant for as long as I was again, okay? Just rip the bandage off next time and you’ll spare them all of the pain in the world.
: Not all of it. You’re hurting just as much now as you were when you found out about me.
: Yes, but some of this pain was my choice.
: And all of my pain is my choice.
: Not all of it. That’s just what it sounds like when you’ve given up.
: What happens now then?
: What happens now is you go meet up with Rin.
: You take her somewhere nice. You don’t mention anything about me. You make her smile and realize how wonderful she is. And you treasure her.
: It’s really that easy. It just feels hard whenever you remember everything else that exists.
: I meant with us.
: What happens to you and me?
: I suppose that depends on whether or not you can still look at me without being overcome by rage.
: Does that get easier with time?
: A little bit. My blood still boils when I look into your eyes and remember all the lies, though.
: I won’t lie anymore. Not to you, at least.
: But to everyone else?
: Can I...hug you? Please?
: You don’t need to ask, idiot.
: I feel like I do now. Is this what it’s like to live in shame?
: You have nothing to feel ashamed about. You didn’t get enough love from me, so you just looked for it somewhere else.
: Does this mean you don’t get enough from me?
: That I could have prevented all of this if I just loved you a little more?
: Chika...
: If you loved me any more, I imagine we’d both be dead by now.
: Heheh...
: You know...
: Maybe we should be...
Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
